visualCharacteristics.purpose: Article byline: author names, published and updated dates, and round print / email / LinkedIn share buttons on the right
visualCharacteristics.description: Authors in blue (Neulis Sans 500 20px/25px), Published line navy 500, Updated line navy 400 italic, 10px line gap; three 42px round share buttons (print: white with blue ring, email and LinkedIn: solid blue) with 10px gap. Band option paints a full-bleed #f3f3f3 band behind the row (50px top / 33px bottom padding at desktop).

contentPattern.description: Authors 'Nick Zylkowski, CFA', 'Christina Shockley'; 'Published: August 27, 2025'; 'Updated: October 27, 2025'
contentPattern.structure: row 1: authors (one paragraph per author, optional links); row 2: 'Published: …' line; row 3: 'Updated: …' line. Lines are classified by text: 'Published…' and 'Updated…' are dates, all other lines are authors. Share buttons are generated by JS.

usage: Byline row at the top of an insight/blog article body, directly under the hero.
reuseGuidance: Use once per article, directly below the article hero. Use the band option to paint the full-width light-grey band behind the row. Share buttons need no authoring.

shareButtons.email: mailto link with the page H1 (or document title) as subject and title + URL as body
shareButtons.linkedin: link to https://www.linkedin.com/sharing/share-offsite/?url=<page URL>, opens in a new window
